market_definition: The flexible polyurethane foam market comprises open-cell polyurethane foams made from polyol and isocyanate that are soft, resilient and compressible. It measures sales of slabstock and moulded foam excluding HR, viscoelastic, reticulated and rebonded grades. BY MANUFACTURING PROCESS: Slabstock, Moulded. BY POLYOL BASE: Polyether, Polyester. BY DENSITY: Low Density, Medium Density, High Density. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Furniture & Bedding, Automotive & Transportation, Building & Construction, Packaging & Protective Cushioning, Appliances & Cold Chain, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: High-resilience, viscoelastic, reticulated and rebonded polyurethane foams; rigid and semi-rigid polyurethane foams; polyurethane raw materials. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR / CONVERTER: a distributor, stockist or foam converter / fabricator that buys this foam from its makers and sells it (as supplied, or cut, laminated or shaped) to industry. EXCLUDED companies: foam and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. PRODUCT SCOPE (required): "polyurethane" AND ("MDI" OR "TDI" OR "polyol" OR "isocyanate" OR "foam" OR "elastomer") AND ("distributor" OR "wholesaler"). Qualifying: MDI/TDI isocyanates, polyols, PU systems and prepolymers, flexible/rigid PU foam, PU elastomers, adhesives, sealants, coatings, TPU resins. EXCLUDE general chemical distributors with no named PU line, furniture/mattress retailers, and PU machinery suppliers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
